AMD announced the general availability of AMD Instinct MI300X accelerators – with industry leading memory bandwidth performance for generative AI – as well as the AMD Instinct MI300A APU that combines AMD CDNATM 3 and “Zen 4” chiplets to deliver breakthrough performance for HPC and AI workloads.
AMD made significant progress expanding its AI software ecosystem, including unveiling the latest version of its open-source ROCmTM 6, software stack optimized for generative AI.
AMD announced AMD Ryzen 8040 Series mobile processors with an integrated neural processing unit (NPU) on select models for AI.
Acer, ASUS, Lenovo, Razer and other PC OEMs introduced new laptops featuring AMD Ryzen 8040 Series processors, with the first systems on-track to go on sale this quarter. 3
At CES 2024, AMD announced the AMD Ryzen 8000G Series desktop processors that are the first desktop PC processors in the industry to include a dedicated AI NPU to power AI capabilities on the PC.
Eni announced a new supercomputer, HPC6, powered by AMD EPYC CPUs and AMD Instinct GPUs.
AMD introduced the AMD Radeon RX 7600 XT GPU, a high-performance graphics card designed to deliver immersive 1080P gaming experiences.
AMD introduced the AMD VersalTM AI Edge XA Series and AMD Ryzen Embedded V2000A devices designed for automotive focus segments including infotainment, advanced driver safety and autonomous driving.
AMD announced the AMD Ryzen Embedded 7000 Series processors, delivering leadership performance and advanced features for industrial and edge solutions.
